verdict.rationale: Angular's official CLI provides scriptable commands for unit tests, end-to-end tests, linting, deployment, configuration, and cache management, which are the building blocks of CI automation. The evidence never explicitly documents headless or CI usage. missing for 10: explicit CI/headless documentation (e.g. non-interactive flags, headless browser test runs, CI pipeline guides), independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
